name: Korozda
description: The Golgari maze of concentric circles leading to Svogthos.

timeline.summary: Kaya ghosts through Ral and aims his face at Rat so he can see her; Rat explains she tracked him for Hekara.
timeline.quote: From behind, Mistress Kaya literally grabbed his face in both of her once-again-solidified hands and aimed it at, well . . . me.

pages_say.description: The immense circular maze of fungal hedgerows and ruins around the Golgari Guildhall.
The Golgari guildhall where the liches confer.
The Golgari maze of concentric circles leading to Svogthos.
A Golgari site that rose to the surface and reshaped the warrens.
